dialogue.grandline.crew.taken: I already sail with another captain. Good winds to you, though — maybe we'll meet at the end of the line.
dialogue.grandline.notable.aldric: History is a garden. Some things must be pruned so that the rest may grow. You have been reading things, haven't you? How very untidy.
dialogue.grandline.notable.aria: I fell out of the sky when I was six. True story! I've been building balloons ever since to get home. Mister Shakkin owns my workshop now. And my balloon. And my debts.
dialogue.grandline.notable.aria.crew: Sky's clear, Captain! I can see three islands and a gull carrying a sausage. I can't see home yet. But I'm looking.
dialogue.grandline.notable.aria.joined: "My balloon can wait. I want to see what's below the clouds before I go back above them. Up to the crow's nest!"
dialogue.grandline.notable.asagao: The Captain lets anyone sit at her table. I'm the reason they behave. Mind your manners and your blade, rookie.
dialogue.grandline.notable.astrid: GWAHAHA! Seventy years, and Ylva still hasn't made me cry with her cooking! Today, though... today I put pepper in my sleeve, just in case.
dialogue.grandline.notable.augustin: Lot forty-seven! A rare specimen, ladies and gentlemen and Saints! Do I hear a hundred million? Oh — and you, sir, are you buying or for sale?
dialogue.grandline.notable.aurelia: Ha! You made it all the way out here? Pour yourself a drink. I was the King's cabin girl, you know — I still carry his broken compass. Beat me to the end, and it's yours.
dialogue.grandline.notable.ayame: Rules are just knots someone else tied. I'm very good at untying them. And retying them around your ankles.
dialogue.grandline.notable.barnum: Step right up, step right up! Welcome to the Midnight Carnival, where the music never stops and nobody ever, EVER leaves! Ahahaha! You'd make a lovely attraction.
dialogue.grandline.notable.bartolo: Scoop! Scoop! Everything's a scoop if you print it big enough! Say, you've got the face of a front page. Mind if I follow you around for a decade or so?
dialogue.grandline.notable.bjorn: Stone doesn't hurry. Stone doesn't lie. Stone outlasts kings. Tell me what you're fighting for, and say it like a stone would.
dialogue.grandline.notable.bolt: Psst! Down here! Don't step on the workshop! I'm building a cannon that fires smaller cannons. The Drill Lord wants it. He's not getting it.
dialogue.grandline.notable.bolt.crew: Down here, Captain! I rebuilt the cannons while you were sleeping. They're twice as loud now. Is that good? It FEELS good.
dialogue.grandline.notable.bolt.joined: "Tontatta hands are small, but our ideas are enormous. Let me build you something nobody's seen before!"
dialogue.grandline.notable.brick: Hard hat zone. Keep your hands off the keels and your nose out of the drafting room, and we'll get along fine.
dialogue.grandline.notable.brunhilde: Half giant, all trouble! I came to Little Garden to find my grandmother's people and stayed for the fight. Wanna arm-wrestle?
dialogue.grandline.notable.carmen: You hear that? No? Exactly! No music in Orange Town since Rotgut came. I can ring like a cathedral bell — ate a funny fruit as a kid — but a one-woman band is just noise.
dialogue.grandline.notable.carmen.crew: TA-DAAA! Morning fanfare, Captain! Want a fight song, a sea shanty, or the Bell-Bell special? The special breaks windows.
dialogue.grandline.notable.carmen.joined: "A band needs a stage and an audience. You've got a whole sea of both! Count me in — one, two, three, four!"
dialogue.grandline.notable.cassius: Every admiral, every fleet, every Buster Call answers to my seal. Do you know how many islands I have never needed to visit twice?
dialogue.grandline.notable.celestine: Welcome to the Rainbase casino, where the house always wins and the house is me. Place your bets. Your ship would make a fine stake.
dialogue.grandline.notable.constance: Justice that bends is no justice at all. I have never bent. Not for kings, not for Saints, not for the weeping. Remember that when you choose your side.
dialogue.grandline.notable.coralie: La la laaa — oh! A fan? No? A rival? Even better! Rivals make the best audiences. They never look away.
dialogue.grandline.notable.dmitri: Ten battleships, ten vice admirals, one order: leave nothing standing. I have carried out four Buster Calls. I sleep fine. Mostly.
dialogue.grandline.notable.doubloon: Welcome, welcome, honoured guests! Drink, eat, sleep soundly! We'll... settle the bill in the morning. Every bill gets settled, eventually.
dialogue.grandline.notable.edison: Fascinating! Your bone density, your stance, your obviously poor impulse control — you'd make a marvellous test subject. Hold this. Don't press the red button.
dialogue.grandline.notable.elowen: The Professor calls me her assistant. I'm really here for the telescope. One star over the New World never moves. Stars don't do that. Something is holding it in place.
dialogue.grandline.notable.elowen.crew: The stars are shifting, Captain. The one over Lodestar never moves. I want to know why. I think you do too.
dialogue.grandline.notable.elowen.joined: "My people burned their wings to fall from the sky. I would like to fly again — on your ship, if you'll have me."
dialogue.grandline.notable.farthing: Mr. Doubloon does the smiling. I do the counting. Right now I'm counting you. One... two...
dialogue.grandline.notable.felicity: Nyahaha, don't check your pockets, it's rude. I only steal from people who deserve it. Everyone deserves it a little.
dialogue.grandline.notable.fennimore: Life's a high wire, friend! One wrong step and — whoops! — down you go. Care to dance on the rope with me?
dialogue.grandline.notable.florian: Welcome to Dressrosa, land of love, passion and the Colosseum! I am your beloved king. I am very beloved. Everyone says so, because I pay them to.
dialogue.grandline.notable.fosco: BRING ME THE RECIPE BOOK! I have eaten forty-one restaurants and I am still HUNGRY! This floating one will be number forty-two!
dialogue.grandline.notable.fumio: Hmph. You tie knots like a seagull with mittens. I sailed with the Saltfire King, you know. Fix that bowline and maybe I'll tell you where the real sea begins.
dialogue.grandline.notable.gallowgate: The Justice Levy is due. Ten thousand Beli, or the collar. I don't care which — both keep this town in line.
dialogue.grandline.notable.gelato: By royal decree, all visitors must taste the national sorbet! Too cold? Too sweet? Speak, speak, the crown is listening!
dialogue.grandline.notable.gizmo: Tick tock, tick tock! My clockwork sharks are winding up the regatta, and that champion sloop is MINE now. Want to see what the sharks do? They bite.
dialogue.grandline.notable.gorgo: Humans pay the tangerine tax or they pay in teeth. Grrahaha! The Keep stands as long as I do — and I don't fall.
dialogue.grandline.notable.gorou: The Kraken doesn't take visitors. He takes tribute. If you've got none, you'll be the tribute.
dialogue.grandline.notable.gregor: On this island there is no trial, no appeal, and no exit. I am the jury, and I have already reached my verdict.
dialogue.grandline.notable.grimsby: Six levels down, no stairs up. Nobody has ever left my prison except as paperwork. Visiting hours are over. Permanently.
dialogue.grandline.notable.gunnar: Hm. I'm a Stonehide. We don't move unless there's a reason. Ayame cheats. That's a reason.
dialogue.grandline.notable.gunnar.crew: Stand behind me, Captain. That's where people who matter stand. I'm a wall. Walls don't talk much. ...That was a lot of talking.
dialogue.grandline.notable.gunnar.joined: "You beat her fair. Fair is rare. I'll walk where you walk, and nothing gets past me."
dialogue.grandline.notable.haakon: Lvneel was built by explorers who sailed off the edge of the map and came back with stories. You have an explorer's face. We'll see if you have the luck.
dialogue.grandline.notable.hagane: Wano bows to the Kraken, and the Kraken lets Wano breathe. That is peace, outsider. Draw your sword in my capital and you will learn what war is.
dialogue.grandline.notable.haruka: So you're the one who keeps sailing toward trouble. Good. Sit. If they're going to burn me, I'd rather spend the wait talking to someone who still believes in the horizon.
dialogue.grandline.notable.hesper: A flame that burns on salt water, visible from every sea. The Throne wants one by spring. I'm SO close. Don't touch anything glowing.
dialogue.grandline.notable.hilde: They call me 'Little' Hilde because I'm the smallest giant on the island. Don't laugh! Try this. It's only a snack. A giant snack.
dialogue.grandline.notable.hilde.crew: Captain! I made a pot of stew the size of a rowboat. Eat before you plan anything stupid. Eat DURING the stupid, if you have to.
dialogue.grandline.notable.hilde.joined: "Grandma says a cook who has never tasted the whole sea isn't a cook. I'm coming with you! I'll bring the big ladle!"
dialogue.grandline.notable.hisui: You dare set foot on Amazon Lily? Bold. Foolish, but bold. I do not bow to the Government's summons, and I do not bow to you. Impress me, or leave.
dialogue.grandline.notable.hollis: Three guilds, one city, and someone tried to put a spike through my head last week. Welcome to Water 7! Need a ship? Everyone does.
dialogue.grandline.notable.horatio: Mmf — I'm off duty! Off duty means I'm eating. If you're a pirate, come back after dessert and I'll arrest you properly. Have you tried the sea-king stew?
dialogue.grandline.notable.hrolf: HAH! A little one with a big stare. Every harbour under my flag sleeps soundly, rookie. Calloway was my rival and my friend. Show me what he would have seen in you.
dialogue.grandline.notable.hugo: The Lodge has one rule: the bounty is the law, but the law isn't always the bounty. Pirates here throw parties. Hunters here drink water. Learn why.
dialogue.grandline.notable.ignatz: Shh! Keep your voice down. I keep the Ledger's books, and there's an entry here I can't un-see: payments for salting a kingdom's wells. I need to leave. Tonight.
dialogue.grandline.notable.ignatz.crew: Captain, I've balanced the books. We're broke, but we're broke in a very organised way. Shall I itemise the cannonballs?
dialogue.grandline.notable.ignatz.joined: "I kept the Ledger's books for nine years. Now I'll keep yours. Fair prices, honest accounts, and a very sharp pencil."
dialogue.grandline.notable.isadora: Ilisia welcomes travellers, poets, and anyone brave enough to clear the royal road of brigands. Which of those are you?
dialogue.grandline.notable.jinpachi: The world's strongest blade is not a title. It is a loneliness. Draw if you wish. I will tell you what your sword is missing.
dialogue.grandline.notable.kagerou: A swallow does not fight the wind. It rides it. Your stance fights everything, including the floor. Again.
dialogue.grandline.notable.kaimon: I followed Gorgo because he said he'd give Fish-Men pride. Taxing children's tangerines isn't pride. Stand aside, human — or stand with me.
dialogue.grandline.notable.kaimon.crew: Captain. The sea's calm and the crew's fed. When we reach the next island, let me go ashore first. People should see a Fish-Man smile.
dialogue.grandline.notable.kaimon.joined: "Gorgo said Fish-Men and humans can't stand on the same deck. Let's prove him wrong for the rest of my life."
dialogue.grandline.notable.kanna: A good joint doesn't need nails. Mortise, tenon, a bit of faith. My family's guild built ships like that for a hundred years, until somebody framed us. Need a hull?
dialogue.grandline.notable.kanna.crew: She's holding together, Captain. Mostly. I've got three new ideas for the keel and one of them only explodes a little.
dialogue.grandline.notable.kanna.joined: "A shipwright who never sails is just a carpenter with nice tools. Let's see what the Grand Line does to my joinery."
dialogue.grandline.notable.kenji: Welcome to the Baratie. Table for one? Please wipe your boots. If you start a fight, I will serve you to the sea in two neat portions. Thank you.
dialogue.grandline.notable.kenji.crew: Captain. Lunch is in an hour. Please wash your hands. If anyone attacks us, they'll be served first — with both knives.
dialogue.grandline.notable.kenji.joined: "The Baratie taught me manners. You'll teach me the sea. Let's see who learns more. Please. Thank you."
dialogue.grandline.notable.kiko: Sea-karate isn't about punching the ocean. It's about letting the ocean punch for you. Feet wider. Wider! There.
dialogue.grandline.notable.kurogane: Everything on this sea is a wager. Your ship, your crew, your life. I never refuse a bet... and I have never forgiven a cheat. So. What are you willing to lose?
dialogue.grandline.notable.leonhart: GARUUU! I signed the Government's charter so no fleet would ever come for this island. Now speak honestly, outsider. Minks can smell a lie.
dialogue.grandline.notable.leopold: Every current, every route, every Calm Belt crossing is mine to grant. The sea is not free, little sailor. It merely forgets to send the bill.
dialogue.grandline.notable.lucrezia: Oh, what a lovely reflection you have. It would look so much better on my wall. Hold still, darling, and smile.
dialogue.grandline.notable.lysander: A firefly is a small light. Ten thousand of them light a forest. The Commander sees the forest; I count the fireflies. You may count as one.
dialogue.grandline.notable.mahina: Eat first, talk later! Nobody leaves my kitchen hungry — not even the Saltfire King did, and he tried. There. Now, you've got that look. The sea is calling, isn't it?
dialogue.grandline.notable.marzipan: Papa makes the noise; I keep the books. Every ticket sold, every soul that wanders into the fair. You look like a soul that wandered in.
dialogue.grandline.notable.matthias: Peace be with you. Then a sermon. Then my fist, if the sermon doesn't take. Tell me, rookie, do you repent of anything?
dialogue.grandline.notable.meridian: The line between justice and murder is thin as a meridian. I walk it every day. Some days I wonder which side of it I'm standing on.
dialogue.grandline.notable.minerva: Oh good, a living sample. I mean visitor. Visitor! Sorry. I've been alone with forty-nine robot assistants for six years. They're terrible conversationalists.
dialogue.grandline.notable.mireille: The South Blue is hot, loud and very, very tired of being told to kneel. Kick first, explain later — that's my motto. What's yours?
dialogue.grandline.notable.mortimer: Every ship sinks eventually. I just like to be there with a shovel. Don't worry, I dig very nice holes.
dialogue.grandline.notable.morwenna: Kneel, child. The world does not need to understand the Throne. It only needs to believe there is one.
dialogue.grandline.notable.nadir: Down here at the bottom of things, everything is quiet. You'll find that comforting, eventually.
dialogue.grandline.notable.nimbus: You shouldn't be up here. I'm supposed to stop you. I've been trained since I was eight to stop people like you. ...Why aren't I stopping you?
dialogue.grandline.notable.nimbus.crew: Nobody followed us, Captain. Two people tried. I fogged their compasses. They're probably still sailing in circles.
dialogue.grandline.notable.nimbus.joined: "CP9 taught me to vanish. You taught me there was somewhere worth reappearing. I'm yours, Captain. In the fog and out of it."
dialogue.grandline.notable.nimue: Good afternoon! The Guildmaster is very busy, but I can take a message. Your name, crew and... current location of every blueprint you've seen? Just for the files.
dialogue.grandline.notable.nox: You came all this way. I'm touched, truly. I sold the Lamplighter, you know. It was nothing personal. Neither is this.
dialogue.grandline.notable.odile: Charts! Genuine Grand Line charts, only slightly invented! Fine, they're forged. I need the money for my almanac — the first one that'll ever predict Grand Line weather. You laugh. Everyone laughs.
dialogue.grandline.notable.odile.crew: Wind's backing south-southwest, swell's rising, and you're about to do something reckless. I've already written it down. Where to, Captain?
dialogue.grandline.notable.odile.joined: "Fine! But I'm charting every storm we sail through — and you're carrying the barometer."
dialogue.grandline.notable.oleander: They burned the scholars here and called it law. I come back every year to remind the ashes we haven't forgotten. Speak softly in this place.
dialogue.grandline.notable.osric: Chin up, recruit! An anchor holds the ship so it can ride out the storm. That's what a Marine is. Now give me fifty push-ups and we'll talk.
dialogue.grandline.notable.ottavia: Everything has a price. Kingdoms, histories, people. Yours is unfortunately rather low.
dialogue.grandline.notable.panacea: Feeling poorly? Of course you are! Everyone on Drum is poorly, and only Panacea Tonic helps! Five thousand Beli a bottle. Ten for the strong stuff.
dialogue.grandline.notable.pashmina: GARU! An outsider on Zou! Sniff... you smell of salt and trouble. I like trouble! The Thunder-Mane says I'm too restless for a guard. He's right!
dialogue.grandline.notable.pashmina.crew: GARUUU! Morning, Captain! I smell three ships, a storm and someone's lunch! Let's go get all three!
dialogue.grandline.notable.pashmina.join: "The Thunder-Mane gave his oath; now I give mine. Where my captain hunts, Pashmina hunts! GARU!"
dialogue.grandline.notable.percival: Feel that? The wind's turning west to east. It does that when someone's about to leave home. I held the King's helm once. Want to know what he steered by?
dialogue.grandline.notable.petra: Keep your voice down, they're watching the yard. I'm the best shot on this base and they locked me up for refusing to fire on a crowd. Funny kind of justice, isn't it?
dialogue.grandline.notable.petra.crew: Eyes on the horizon, Captain. I've got a clean line on anything that moves. I won't take the shot unless it saves someone — that's my rule.
dialogue.grandline.notable.petra.joined: "I left the Marines to keep my promise: nobody gets shot who doesn't have to be. Point me at what's worth protecting."
dialogue.grandline.notable.pim: Lovely weather for a revolution, isn't it? Ah — don't mind the umbrella. It's for the storm. No, not that one. The other one. The one that's coming.
dialogue.grandline.notable.pipistrello: Down HERE, you oaf! Yes, I'm a Warlord! The smallest Warlord in history and the most magnificent! Bow! Lower! LOWER!
dialogue.grandline.notable.pippa: Tongue out. Say 'ahh'. Hmm. You're healthy, which on Drum is practically a crime. That 'Panacea' rubbish is making everyone sick on purpose, and nobody will listen to me.
dialogue.grandline.notable.pippa.crew: Hold still, Captain, your left shoulder's out again. No, I can reach it from here. Long arms, remember? Now — who else needs patching up?
dialogue.grandline.notable.pippa.joined: "Someone has to keep you alive long enough to regret your decisions. That's a doctor's job. I accept."
dialogue.grandline.notable.pompadour: Ugh, you're breathing MY air. Do you know who I am? Kneel! Kneel and maybe I'll only buy you instead of shooting you.
dialogue.grandline.notable.prudence: Every blade has a lesson in it. Mine is short: draw only for something worth protecting. What do you protect?
dialogue.grandline.notable.rashid: Forgive the dust. I have been trying to grow a forest in a desert for twenty years. Someone has been salting my wells for one. Will you help an old gardener?
dialogue.grandline.notable.raven: Caw. The storm brought you here, same as me. Don't mistake that for us being friends.
dialogue.grandline.notable.rin: My master served Wano. Then the Kraken came, and the shogun bowed, and my master did not. I have a sword and a debt. Which do you want to hear about?
dialogue.grandline.notable.rin.crew: The moon is rising, Captain. When I draw, it will be for Wano and for you. Until then, I'll sharpen in silence.
dialogue.grandline.notable.rin.joined: "A ronin has no lord. I choose a captain instead. Do not make me regret it — I would have to cut you, and that would be awkward."
dialogue.grandline.notable.rotgut: Oranges! Glorious oranges! Every one of 'em going into my still. Marmalade festival? Not this year, sweetheart. This year it's a hangover festival!
dialogue.grandline.notable.rusty: Everything washes up on Spider Miles eventually. Ships, guns, idiots. You're the third kind. Welcome to the scrap heap!
dialogue.grandline.notable.saltmarsh: Water is the only currency that never loses value. I simply... adjust the supply. Kneel, and perhaps I'll sell you a cup.
dialogue.grandline.notable.sefa: There's a stone under the palace older than the kingdom, covered in words nobody is allowed to read. Somebody wants it badly enough to salt a whole country. Isn't that fascinating?
dialogue.grandline.notable.sefa.crew: The stones speak, Captain, if you know their grammar. I'm learning. Every island we visit, I learn a little more of the sentence.
dialogue.grandline.notable.sefa.joined: "The answer to Alabasta's question is written on a stone somewhere out there. I'm going to read it, and you're going to get me there."
dialogue.grandline.notable.seraphine: Welcome to G-5, the Marine base everyone else pretends doesn't exist. We hit hard and break easy. Try not to break anything I need.
dialogue.grandline.notable.shilling: Seventy years of noise. A little wax will fix that. Two giant statues, quiet forever — art, really. You'll make a nice little candle.
dialogue.grandline.notable.sigrid: My father fights with his fists and laughs with his whole chest. I do the worrying for both of us. State your business with Elbaph, small one.
dialogue.grandline.notable.sigrun: Every night ends. The Throne believes otherwise. We are patient, we are everywhere, and we are almost ready. Will you be standing in the sun when it rises?
dialogue.grandline.notable.solveig: WHAT? Speak into the good ear! Ha! Thirty years of cannon fire will do that. The King said the North breeds stubborn sailors. Prove him right.
dialogue.grandline.notable.sterling: Everything can be weighed, everything can be traded. A crown, a secret, a friend. What's on your scale, rookie? Let's see if it balances.
dialogue.grandline.notable.tamsin: Sit, sit, you'll hurt your neck looking up. We Whalefolk are gentle until we aren't. The East Blue is my sea. Who's bothering it?
dialogue.grandline.notable.thaddeus: Eighty years on the sea and I still get seasick on land. The star over this island never moves, did you notice? That's not an accident.
dialogue.grandline.notable.tobias: HEY! YOU! You're a rookie too, right?! Let's have a race to the end of the Grand Line! Loser buys meat! WINNER BUYS MORE MEAT!
dialogue.grandline.notable.tomas: I was a helmsman once. Best in the East Blue, they said. Then I put a ship on the rocks at the foot of Reverse Mountain. Now I fix fishing nets. And now that pirate's stolen my sloop.
dialogue.grandline.notable.tomas.crew: Steady as she goes, Captain. Don't worry about the waves — I've stopped worrying about them myself. Mostly thanks to you.
dialogue.grandline.notable.tomas.joined: "I swore I'd never touch a wheel again. Then you went and won my sloop back. Fine. I steer. You stop hitting the rocks."
dialogue.grandline.notable.tsubaki: Two blades, one rule: whatever comes in with the tide goes back out in pieces. Draw, or leave.
dialogue.grandline.notable.tsukumo: ...Shh. Listen. No, with the other ears. Two Emperors sat on this rock and heard nothing for a year. You have less time than that.
dialogue.grandline.notable.ulfric: BOOM! Ha, sorry, habit. Welcome to Elbaph! The Captain likes guests who don't flinch. Did you flinch? You flinched a little.
dialogue.grandline.notable.ume: I coated the Saltfire King's ship, you know. Ten thousand metres down and back with nothing but a bubble and his big stupid grin. Let's see your hull.
dialogue.grandline.notable.usurio: Everyone in this town owes me. The bars, the crews, that little balloon girl. Interest is due daily. Hourly, for you.
dialogue.grandline.notable.valka: Every rookie in the East Blue passes through Loguetown, and every one of them meets me. Most of them meet me twice: once here, once in a cell.
dialogue.grandline.notable.vespera: You cast a very interesting shadow. I collect those. Stand still — this won't hurt for very long.
dialogue.grandline.notable.wilhelmina: Another rookie climbing the mountain that flows upward! Take a Log Pose, dear. My sister wrote to me every year for twenty-four years. This year the letter didn't come.
dialogue.grandline.notable.ylva: Astrid thinks she's winning. Astrid has thought she's winning since before your grandparents were born. Taste this. Be honest.
dialogue.grandline.notable.zenith: Ahh, so bright today, isn't it? The sun at its highest point casts no shadow at all. Neither will you, if you make me hurry.
grandline.crew.dismissed: %s has left the crew and is heading home.
grandline.crew.lost: %s has fallen. Your crew will never be the same.
grandline.crew.lost_arrested: %s has been arrested and taken away.
grandline.notable.arrested: %s, %s, has been arrested and taken to Impel Down.
grandline.notable.credit_arrested: %s was taken away in seastone cuffs. The islanders tell you who did it (%s).
grandline.notable.credit_fallen: %s is gone. The islanders tell you how it ended (%s).
grandline.notable.fallen: %s, %s, has fallen. The sea will remember.
grandline.notable.spared: %s lowers their weapon and hauls you to your feet. "Not today."

quest.grandline.alabasta_1.desc: Alabasta's oases are turning to salt. Reach the kingdom, hear King Rashid out and stop 6 of the well-salters.
quest.grandline.alabasta_2.desc: The Gilded Ledger's vice-president runs the Rainbase casino. Defeat Madam Sovereign and seize the company's books.
quest.grandline.alabasta_2.marine.desc: A Warlord can't be arrested without proof. Defeat Madam Sovereign and take King Rashid's testimony.
quest.grandline.alabasta_2.revolutionary: Speak with King Rashid, then defend the oasis towns from 8 Ledger raiders while the Revolutionary cells arm the people.
quest.grandline.alabasta_3.bounty_hunter: Saltmarsh's charter protects him from the law — not from a bounty the King himself just posted. Defeat the Salt Baron.
quest.grandline.alabasta_3.civilian.desc: While others fight the Salt Baron, someone has to get water to the towns. Speak with King Rashid and guard the caravans from 6 pirates.
quest.grandline.alabasta_3.desc: The Ledger's President is the Warlord Sir Barnaby Saltmarsh. Defeat the Salt Baron and give Alabasta back its water.
quest.grandline.alabasta_3.marine.desc: With the evidence in hand, the charter can't protect him. Defeat Sir Barnaby Saltmarsh and arrest a Warlord.
quest.grandline.baltigo_1.desc: Reach Baltigo and hear the Revolutionary Army's plan from Sigrun Yoake and Lysander Hotaru.
quest.grandline.baltigo_1.marine.desc: Vice Admiral Prudence Hagane leads a raid on the Revolutionary headquarters. Reach Baltigo, defeat Lysander Hotaru and report to Hagane.
Return to Baltigo and report to Supreme Commander Sigrun and Chief of Staff Lysander.
quest.grandline.baratie_1.desc: The Gourmand's glutton fleet is boarding the Baratie between courses. Reach the floating restaurant and talk to Kenji, its head waiter.
quest.grandline.baratie_1.marine.desc: Vice Admiral Horatio 'Hambone' Okonomi is off duty at the Baratie. Reach the restaurant, pay your respects to the Vice Admiral, and talk to Kenji, the head waiter.
quest.grandline.baratie_2.desc: Fosco 'the Gourmand' Ragout wants the Baratie's recipe book and he won't say please. Defeat him.
quest.grandline.cake_1.desc: Whole Cake Island is a fair that never ends — and visitors who never leave. Reach it, defeat 10 carnival pirates and the acrobat Fennimore 'Tightrope'.
quest.grandline.cake_2.desc: Defeat Marzipan 'Sugarplum' Candlewick and the Emperor Barnum 'Waxwork' Candlewick to take the third rubbing.
quest.grandline.capes_1.desc: Talk with Old Wick at the Twin Capes lighthouse and see off 3 of the pirates who prey on crews too dizzy from the climb.
quest.grandline.capes_2.desc: Old Wick's sister — the Lamplighter — is in hiding, and somebody is reading her letters. Follow the Log Pose to Whisky Peak, and if you ever hear of Haruka, tell Wick.
quest.grandline.cocoyasi_1.desc: Gorgo 'Hammerjaw' Shumoku has walled Cocoyasi's waterfront into a fortress and taxes every tangerine. Reach Cocoyasi and defeat 2 of his Fish-Man guards.
quest.grandline.cocoyasi_2.desc: Hammerjaw comes through his gate with the tide behind him. Defeat Gorgo Shumoku.
quest.grandline.dress_1.desc: Dressrosa's Colosseum offers a Road Poneglyph rubbing as its grand prize. Reach Dressrosa and win 10 bouts.
quest.grandline.dress_2.desc: King Florian is a puppet, and the Fence holds the strings. Defeat him and claim the first rubbing.
quest.grandline.drum_1.desc: Drum Island is hooked on 'Panacea Tonic'. Reach the island and find Dr. Pippa Frostwhistle, the doctor who said it was poison.
quest.grandline.drum_2.desc: Doctor Quentin Panacea is a quack, and his tonic keeps people sick on purpose. Climb the drum mountain and defeat him.
quest.grandline.egghead_1.desc: Professor Minerva Tensai wants to defect, and CP0 has come to stop her. Reach Egghead, speak with Minerva and defeat Vespera Kagenui.
quest.grandline.elbaph_1.desc: Reach Elbaph, prove yourself against Sigrid 'Hearth-Shield' Kumobashi and speak with the Emperor Hrolf.
quest.grandline.ember_east_1.desc: Bandits raided Shiokaze's harbour shed and carried the island's supplies into the hills. Old Fumio sends you after them and watches how you fight: land a blow, guard one, dodge one and use a technique (ask him for a practice bout first if you like) — and drive off 3 bandits.
quest.grandline.ember_east_2.desc: The supply sloop came home a third short and without its skipper — Fumio's granddaughter Mio, who went to argue with the Shells Town Marines about their 'Justice Levy'. Sail to Shells Town and find her.
quest.grandline.ember_north_1.desc: Bandits stole the whalers' harpoon guns. Grandma Sólveig sends you after them and watches how you fight: land a blow, guard one, dodge one and use a technique (ask her for a practice bout first if you like) — and defeat 3 of the bandits.
quest.grandline.ember_north_2.desc: The harpoon guns were sold to Rusty the Scrap Baron. Sail to Spider Miles and find out what he wants with every gun in the North Blue.
quest.grandline.ember_south_1.desc: Thieves cleaned out Auntie Mahina's pantry. She sends you after them and watches how you fight: land a blow, guard one, dodge one and use a technique (ask her for a practice bout first if you like) — and defeat 3 of the thieves.
quest.grandline.ember_south_2.desc: Mahina says every South Blue sailor should learn to let the ocean punch for them. Sail to Karate Island.
quest.grandline.ember_west_1.desc: Brigands took Kirinoha's wool caravan. Uncle Percival sends you after them and watches how you fight: land a blow, guard one, dodge one and use a technique (ask him for a practice bout first if you like) — and defeat 3 of the brigands.
quest.grandline.ember_west_2.desc: Percival sends you to Kano Country, where a sword master teaches you to ride the wind instead of fighting it. Sail there.
quest.grandline.enies_1.desc: Cipher Pol dragged its prisoners — Kanna's father among them — to Enies Lobby. Storm the island of law and defeat 3 agents in the Tower of Justice.
quest.grandline.enies_1.marine.desc: You've been assigned to Vice Admiral Kawaragi's fleet for an operation at Enies Lobby. Report to him and stop 6 pirates trying to reach the tower.
quest.grandline.enies_2.desc: CP9 Director Gregor Hanzaki holds the Tower of Justice. Defeat him.
quest.grandline.enies_2.marine.desc: The Buster Call order has come — with civilians and prisoners still on the island. Talk to the CP9 trainee Nimbus and to Vice Admiral Kawaragi, and hold off 6 pirates while you evacuate.
quest.grandline.enies_3.bounty_hunter.de: Your contract died with the Tower. Collect what you can: 6 pirates fleeing the Buster Call.
quest.grandline.enies_3.civilian.desc: Someone has to tell the world what happened here. Interview Nimbus and Vice Admiral Kawaragi before the island burns.
quest.grandline.enies_3.desc: The Buster Call has begun. Fight your way out past 6 Marines.
quest.grandline.enies_3.marine.desc: Report to Vice Admiral Kawaragi and stop 6 pirates looting the ruins.
quest.grandline.enies_3.revolutionary.de: Every prisoner on this island walks out free tonight. Hold off 6 Marines while the cells are opened.
quest.grandline.fishman_occupation.desc: Free Cocoyasi from the Fish-Man pirates of the Coral Keep.
quest.grandline.garden_1.desc: On prehistoric Little Garden two giant grandmothers have been cooking against each other for seventy years. Reach the island and find Astrid Kamameshi at the duel ground.
quest.grandline.garden_2.desc: The Ledger's Mr. Shilling plans to end the bake-off by sealing both giants in wax. Defeat him.
quest.grandline.greenbit_1.desc: The ex-Warlord Pipistrello 'the Drill Lord' Minimaro is terrorising the Tontatta. Reach Green Bit and defeat him (look down).
quest.grandline.hachinosu_1.desc: Sterling 'the Fence' Okanemochi stole the holder list at Marineford and bought himself an Emperor's seat. Reach Hachinosu and defeat him.
quest.grandline.hachinosu_1.marine.desc: The ex-Warlord Sterling Okanemochi is the most wanted man in the world. Reach Hachinosu and bring him down.
quest.grandline.impel_1.bounty_hunter.de: The Government is paying hunters to guard the transfer. Report to Chief Warden Grimsby and stop 6 pirates who want her free.
quest.grandline.impel_1.desc: The Lamplighter is held in Impel Down. Reach the great prison and fight down through 2 jailers and 2 of the beasts below.
quest.grandline.impel_1.marine.desc: You're posted to Impel Down for the transfer. Report to Chief Warden Grimsby and put down 6 pirates attempting a breakout.
quest.grandline.jaya_1.desc: In lawless Jaya everyone owes Usurio Shakkin. Reach the island, meet the thief Felicity Nekomata and break 8 of the Debt Collector's enforcers.
quest.grandline.jaya_2.desc: Defeat Usurio 'the Debt Collector' Shakkin and burn his debt books — including the one on Aria's balloon workshop.
quest.grandline.kuraigana_1.desc: The ex-Warlord Jinpachi Grimaldi trains swordsmen who can survive a blade like his. Reach Kuraigana Island and cross swords with him.
quest.grandline.laughtale_1.desc: Sail to the final island. Nox 'the Miasma' Tsukuyomi got there first with CP0's last orders. Defeat him.
quest.grandline.laughtale_2.bounty_hunte: The last bounty in the world is on this flame. Read the stone — and cancel every bounty there is, your own included.
quest.grandline.laughtale_2.civilian.des: Read the stone, then bring Bartolo Scoop the photograph that will run in a thousand ports.
quest.grandline.laughtale_2.desc: Read the stone at the heart of the island and kindle the beacon. Let every sea see what the King saw.
quest.grandline.laughtale_2.marine.desc: Read the stone. The Stewards ordered you to extinguish it. Instead, stand guard over the light so the world can read it.
quest.grandline.laughtale_2.revolutionar: Read the stone, then carry the Saltfire to Mary Geoise — Juniper 'Ashfoot' Kurai will open the Holy Land's back stairs — and set the Pale Throne alight.
quest.grandline.lily_1.desc: The Kuja empress refuses the Government's summons to the war. Reach Amazon Lily and earn her respect in a duel.
quest.grandline.lodestar_1.desc: With all four rubbings, only one gate remains. Reach Lodestar Island and defeat Asagao 'Morning Glory' and the Emperor Aurelia Hinode.
quest.grandline.logue_1: The Town of Beginnings and Endings
quest.grandline.logue_1.desc: Every road in the East Blue ends at the execution platform where the Saltfire King died. Reach Loguetown and meet Bartolo Scoop of the Sea-Gull Gazette.
quest.grandline.logue_2.bounty_hunter.de: Tobias 'Firecracker' Kagaribi has a fresh bounty and no sense. Claim him, and 5 bandits besides.
quest.grandline.logue_2.civilian.desc: Bartolo wants interviews for the anniversary edition: the Marine (Valka), the rookie (Tobias) and the mysterious umbrella (Pim).
quest.grandline.logue_2.desc: The rookie Tobias 'Firecracker' Kagaribi wants a duel, and Captain Valka Shiranui wants you both in chains. Beat Tobias and fight off 5 Marines.
quest.grandline.logue_2.marine.desc: Captain Valka puts you on rookie duty. Bring in Tobias 'Firecracker' Kagaribi and round up 5 bandits who flocked to town for the anniversary.
quest.grandline.logue_2.revolutionary.de: Pim Amagasa needs the storm signal lit while Marine eyes are elsewhere. Meet Pim and draw off 3 Marines.
quest.grandline.logue_3.desc: On the anniversary night the pale flame burned on the sea again. Follow it to the Twin Capes at the foot of Reverse Mountain.
quest.grandline.north_lvneel_passage.des: Sail to Lvneel and tell King Haakon the Scrap Baron is finished.
quest.grandline.north_scrap_baron.desc: Rusty Kuzutetsu, the Scrap Baron, is waiting in his junk fortress. Defeat him.
quest.grandline.nw_gate_1.desc: Reach the New World Gate and survive the welcome: 10 pirates who think rookies are easy prey.
quest.grandline.nw_gate_1.marine.desc: You've been posted to G-5. Report to Vice Admiral Seraphine Glasswater and put down 10 pirates.
quest.grandline.oni_1.desc: Reach Onigashima and defeat the Kraken's enforcers, Gorou 'Riptide' Kanemitsu and Tsubaki 'Backwash' Shiranami.
quest.grandline.oni_2.desc: The Emperor Kurogane 'the Kraken' Shiomaru accepts your wager: everything against the fourth rubbing. Defeat him.
quest.grandline.orange_1.desc: Rotgut's distillery pirates have seized Orange Town's orchards three days before the Marmalade Festival. Reach Orange Town and find Carmen Trombetta, the trumpeter at the empty bandstand.
quest.grandline.orange_2.desc: Every orange in town is going into Rotgut's still. Defeat Wendell 'Rotgut' Mostaccio and end the siege.
quest.grandline.personal_aria.desc: Aria wants one look at the sky islands. Sail to Long Ring Long Land and Jaya, clearing 6 pirates from the launch site.
quest.grandline.personal_bolt.desc: Bolt wants to trade blueprints with the greatest scientist alive. Reach Egghead and speak with Professor Minerva.
quest.grandline.personal_carmen.desc: Carmen wants to play for the Merfolk. Reach Sabaody and arrange a duet with the Riptide Diva, Coralie.
quest.grandline.personal_elowen.desc: Elowen wants to know why the star over Lodestar never moves. Reach Lodestar Island and ask Aurelia Hinode.
quest.grandline.personal_gunnar.desc: Gunnar's people came from the giants long ago. Reach Elbaph and speak with the Emperor Hrolf.
quest.grandline.personal_hilde.desc: Hilde wants to cook with ingredients from everywhere. Visit the Baratie and Alabasta, and raid 8 pirate larders on the way.
quest.grandline.personal_ignatz.desc: Ignatz has one account left to close: Madam Sovereign of the Gilded Ledger. Defeat her.
quest.grandline.personal_kaimon.desc: A Fish-Man is still on the auction block at Sabaody. Reach the archipelago and defeat the auctioneer Augustin.
quest.grandline.personal_kanna.desc: Kanna's father is somewhere in Enies Lobby's cells. Sail there and defeat 3 Cipher Pol agents guarding the records.
quest.grandline.personal_kenji.desc: Kenji wants to learn from the world's greatest swordsman. Reach Kuraigana Island and cross blades with Jinpachi Grimaldi.
quest.grandline.personal_nimbus.desc: The head of CP0 trained the officers who trained Nimbus. Reach Egghead and defeat Vespera Kagenui.
quest.grandline.personal_odile.desc: Odile wants readings from the strangest weather in Paradise for her almanac. Sail to Drum Island, Alabasta and Water 7.
quest.grandline.personal_pashmina.desc: Gorou 'Riptide' Kanemitsu once raided Zou. Pashmina wants him beaten under the full moon.
quest.grandline.personal_petra.desc: Petra wants to prove a sniper can protect without killing. Reach Sabaody and take down 3 pirate captains.
quest.grandline.personal_pippa.desc: Pippa thinks the labs on Punk Hazard hold the secret of seastone sickness. Reach the island and consult Professor Minerva Tensai.
quest.grandline.personal_rin.desc: Rin's master fell to the Kraken's duelist. Defeat Tsubaki 'Backwash' Shiranami.
quest.grandline.personal_sefa.desc: Sefa is close to understanding the poneglyph grammar. Read 3 poneglyphs.
quest.grandline.personal_tomas.desc: Tomas wrecked once at the foot of Reverse Mountain. Sail back to the Twin Capes and let Old Wick see him steering again.
quest.grandline.punk_1.desc: Vice Admiral Glasswater's scouts found a Government lab on Punk Hazard forging an artificial Saltfire. Reach the island and stop Dr. Hesper Galvani.
quest.grandline.punk_1.marine.desc: Dr. Galvani's experiments are poisoning the island. Reach Punk Hazard and bring her in.
quest.grandline.recruit_aria.desc: Aria needs parts and a test flight. Defeat 5 pirates guarding a salvage yard and sail with her to Long Ring Long Land.
quest.grandline.recruit_bolt.desc: Bolt Nejimaki wants a field test: defeat 6 pirates with his inventions and visit Dressrosa's scrap markets.
quest.grandline.recruit_carmen.desc: Carmen has something to ask you, and she's going to ask it with a fanfare. Talk to her at the bandstand — then invite her aboard if you want a musician.
quest.grandline.recruit_elowen.desc: Elowen Hoshizora will leave Egghead only once Minerva is safe. Speak with Minerva and defeat 8 raiders.
quest.grandline.recruit_gunnar.desc: Gunnar 'Mossback' Iwakoke wants to see you shake hands with Ayame after beating her. Go talk to her.
quest.grandline.recruit_hilde.desc: Little Hilde is packing a knife roll the size of a canoe. Talk to her — then invite her aboard if you want a cook.
quest.grandline.recruit_ignatz.desc: Ignatz is sitting on his packed bag at the edge of the square. Talk to him — then invite him aboard if you want a quartermaster.
quest.grandline.recruit_kaimon.desc: Kaimon is on the beach, teaching the village children to stand like a wave. Talk to him — then invite him aboard if you want a fighter.
quest.grandline.recruit_kanna.desc: Kanna's family guild was framed. Tell Guildmaster Hollis the truth and defeat 5 pirates the false accusers hired.
quest.grandline.recruit_kenji.desc: Kenji is laying the tables for dinner. Talk to him — then invite him aboard if you need a swordsman.
quest.grandline.recruit_nimbus.desc: Nimbus refused to fire on her own prisoners and now her old squad is hunting her. Defeat 2 Cipher Pol agents.
quest.grandline.recruit_odile.desc: Odile is at the harbour inn with her almanac. Talk to her — then invite her aboard if you want a navigator.
quest.grandline.recruit_pashmina.desc: Pashmina Torafu needs the Thunder-Mane's leave to go. Speak with Leonhart and hunt down 8 pirates who came for Zou.
quest.grandline.recruit_petra.desc: Petra has been offered her old post back. Talk to her at the pier — then, if you want her aboard, invite her to sail with you.
quest.grandline.recruit_pippa.desc: Pippa is mixing medicine in the village square. Talk to her — then invite her aboard if you want a doctor.
quest.grandline.recruit_rin.desc: Rin Tsukishiro wants to see Onigashima with her own eyes before she swears to anyone. Defeat 6 pirates and sail there.
quest.grandline.recruit_sefa.desc: Sefa Ishibumi believes the poneglyphs hold Alabasta's real history. Read a poneglyph and tell King Rashid what it said.
quest.grandline.recruit_tomas.desc: Tomas is at the dock with the Kingfisher. Talk to him — then invite him aboard if you need a helmsman.
quest.grandline.ring_1.desc: Long Ring Long Land's crew-against-crew contest has a cheater: Ayame 'Thousand Knots' Musubi. Beat her fairly and 4 of her crew besides.
quest.grandline.rusukaina_1.desc: Before the war, find the hermit Tsukumo Okina on Rusukaina, who taught two Emperors to listen.
quest.grandline.sabaody_1.desc: Every rookie crew in the world has arrived at Sabaody at once. Reach the archipelago and size up your rivals Coralie and Edison.
quest.grandline.sabaody_2.civilian.desc: Coralie and Ume have a plan to free the captives without a riot. Talk to both and keep 6 pirate troublemakers away from the auction house.
quest.grandline.sabaody_2.desc: The Fence's auctioneer is selling a captured Fish-Man and a Mink to a World Noble. Defeat Augustin 'Gavel' Rakusatsu and 6 auction guards.
quest.grandline.sabaody_2.marine.desc: You're assigned to Admiral Zenith's escort for a World Noble. Report to the Admiral, endure Saint Pompadour, and stop 8 pirates rioting at the auction.
quest.grandline.sabaody_3.desc: Nox Tsukuyomi has sold the Lamplighter's hiding place to CP0, and Admiral Zenith has landed. Break through 8 Marines and get your ship coated by Ume.
quest.grandline.sabaody_3.marine.desc: The Lamplighter has been captured. Report to Admiral Zenith and clear 8 pirates from the groves before the transfer.
quest.grandline.shells_1.desc: At Shells Town's harbour, Captain Gallowgate's men are collecting a 'Justice Levy' at baton-point. Drive off 4 of the levy collectors and see whose names are in their ledger.
quest.grandline.shells_1.marine.desc: As a Marine you can't simply punch your way through a Marine base. Take a resident's statement about the levy and break up 4 of the thugs Gallowgate hired to collect it.
quest.grandline.shells_2.desc: Captain Mordecai 'Iron-Collar' Gallowgate has come out to deal with you himself. Defeat him and free Shells Town from the levy.
quest.grandline.shells_2.marine.desc: The evidence is in: Gallowgate has betrayed the coat. Defeat him and hand him over to Marine justice.
quest.grandline.south_karate_cup.desc: Reach Karate Island, beat 3 challengers and defeat Master Kiko Hamaguri in the final bout.
quest.grandline.south_sorbet_royal.desc: The ice house is free. Return to King Gelato.
quest.grandline.syrup_1.desc: Gizmo Gearhart stole Syrup Village's champion racing sloop and seeded the regatta course with clockwork sharks. Reach the village and find Tomas Kajitori, the helmsman who stopped steering.
quest.grandline.syrup_2.desc: Gizmo stole Tomas Kajitori's champion racing sloop. Defeat the Tinker Pirate and win it back.
quest.grandline.thriller_1.desc: A fog-bound island steals sailors' reflections and turns them into soldiers. Reach Thriller Bark and shatter 8 reflection soldiers.
quest.grandline.thriller_2.desc: Defeat the Warlord Countess Lucrezia Kagamiya and give every sailor back their reflection.
quest.grandline.thriller_2.marine.desc: A Warlord stealing sailors' reflections is a breach of the charter. Defeat Countess Kagamiya.
quest.grandline.wano_1.desc: Wano lives under the Kraken's protectorate and a puppet shogun. Reach Wano, defeat 10 enforcers and Shogun Hagane Oboro.
quest.grandline.war_1.bounty_hunter.desc: Sterling 'the Fence' has hired hunters to grab the Lamplighter in the chaos. Reach Marineford and clear a path through 6 pirates and 4 Marines.
quest.grandline.war_1.civilian.desc: Reach Marineford for the Gazette, get a statement from Vice Admiral Osric and help evacuate 3 townsfolk.
quest.grandline.war_1.desc: The Government will burn the last person who has seen the final island. Sail into the crescent bay of Marineford with Hrolf's fleet and break through 10 Marines.
quest.grandline.war_1.marine.desc: Report to Vice Admiral Osric at Marineford and hold the plaza: stop 10 pirates storming the bay.
quest.grandline.war_1.revolutionary.desc: While the war rages, the Revolutionary Army will broadcast the Government's own orders to the world. Reach Marineford and keep 8 Marines off the transponder snails.
quest.grandline.war_2.bounty_hunter.desc: Reach Haruka — and learn who was really buying her. Then turn on the Fence's other hirelings: 8 pirates.
quest.grandline.war_2.civilian.desc: Get Vice Admiral Osric to agree to a ceasefire for the wounded, then reach Haruka with a doctor's bag.
quest.grandline.war_2.desc: Break through 10 more Marines and reach Haruka Lanthorn on the execution platform.
quest.grandline.war_2.marine.desc: You are standing beside the prisoner when the order comes. Speak with Haruka. Then speak with the Fleet Admiral — and choose.
quest.grandline.war_2.revolutionary.desc: Defeat 8 Marines holding the plaza gates and reach the Lamplighter.
quest.grandline.war_3: Four Red Stones, Then the Star
quest.grandline.war_3.desc: The war is over and the Warlord charter has burned. Haruka has one last sentence for you before she disappears again.
quest.grandline.water7_1.desc: Water 7's guilds are at each other's throats after an attempt on the Guildmaster. Reach the city and hear out the shipwright Kanna and the monk-captain Matthias.
quest.grandline.water7_2.desc: The attackers were Cipher Pol agents hidden in the guild: the secretary Nimue and the foreman Brick. Defeat them both.
quest.grandline.water7_2.marine.desc: Cipher Pol has no authority to assassinate a Guildmaster. Bring the agents Nimue and Brick down and report to Marine command.
quest.grandline.water7_3.desc: Defend the yard from 6 raiders while Kanna Dovetail finishes the work on your ship, then check in with her.
quest.grandline.west_ilisia_audience.des: Bring what you found on the royal road to Queen Isadora of Ilisia. Talk to her.
quest.grandline.west_kano_trial.desc: Reach Kano Country and face Master Kagerou Tsubame in a sparring match. He yields only to those who stop fighting the wind.
quest.grandline.whisky_1.bounty_hunter.d: Report to Grandmaster Hugo at the Hunters' Lodge in Whisky Peak: the Lodge has business with the town's 'hosts'.
quest.grandline.whisky_1.desc: Whisky Peak throws a party for every crew that comes down the mountain. Reach the town and find Hugo Kariudo, Grandmaster of the Hunters' Lodge, at his bar.
quest.grandline.whisky_2.desc: The town is a front for the Gilded Ledger. Defeat its agents Mr. Doubloon and Miss Farthing.
quest.grandline.zou_1.desc: The ex-Warlord Leonhart Raijū guards Zou and the second rubbing. Reach the island on the giant's back and defeat him in an honour duel.
rumor.grandline.story.alabasta: The oases are turning salty, one by one. The King plants trees; something else is planting salt.
rumor.grandline.story.amazon_lily: The Kuja empress was summoned to the war. She sent back a single word, and the Government won't print it.
rumor.grandline.story.baltigo: The Revolutionary Army hides on white rock, in plain sight. The Dawnbringer says the best hiding place is the truth.
rumor.grandline.story.baratie: The head waiter at the Baratie fights with two carving knives. He's very polite about it.
rumor.grandline.story.cocoyasi: There's a Fish-Man in Hammerjaw's gang who slips food to the village kids at night. Gorgo would have his fins if he knew.
rumor.grandline.story.dressrosa: The grand prize at the Colosseum this year isn't gold. It's a sheet of paper. People are killing each other for it.
rumor.grandline.story.drum_island: Panacea Tonic cures everything, they say. Funny how nobody on Drum ever seems to get better.
rumor.grandline.story.egghead: The scientist on Egghead built forty-nine assistants and named every one of them after a vegetable.
rumor.grandline.story.elbaph: On Elbaph even the children are taller than the masts. The Emperor Hrolf laughs so loud the leaves fall in summer.
rumor.grandline.story.enies_lobby: Enies Lobby has no night. The lights of the Tower of Justice never go out.
rumor.grandline.story.fuyugane_isle: Grandma Sólveig keeps a cannon on her porch. Loaded. 'For seagulls,' she says.
rumor.grandline.story.green_bit: The Tontatta have a new Warlord. He's about this tall. Shorter, actually.
rumor.grandline.story.hachinosu: Sterling the Fence calls himself the Fifth Emperor now. Four people in the world disagree, loudly.
rumor.grandline.story.hinata_isle: Auntie Mahina cooked for the Saltfire King. She says he ate like a hurricane and paid like a gentleman.
rumor.grandline.story.ilisia_kingdom: The Queen pays well for every brigand cleared from the royal road. Poets get paid too, but less.
rumor.grandline.story.impel_down: Six levels down, they say. And a seventh nobody admits to.
rumor.grandline.story.jaya: In Jaya, laughing at dreamers is the national sport. Usurio Shakkin owns the stadium.
rumor.grandline.story.kano_country: Master Kagerou can cut a falling leaf in two without disturbing the branch. He says it's 'only manners'.
rumor.grandline.story.karate_island: On Karate Island they punch the waves to train. The waves have not yet surrendered.
rumor.grandline.story.kirinoha_isle: Uncle Percival can tell the weather three days ahead by the smell of the wind. He's never once been wrong. It's unsettling.
rumor.grandline.story.kuraigana_island: The swordsman on Kuraigana is training someone. The ravens won't land on the castle anymore.
rumor.grandline.story.little_garden: Two giant grandmothers have been cooking against each other since before the Saltfire Age. The volcano erupts every time one of them shouts.
rumor.grandline.story.lodestar_island: The star over Lodestar Island never moves. The Daybreak Emperor waits beneath it for someone to beat her to the end.
rumor.grandline.story.loguetown: The platform hasn't been used since the King died. On the anniversary, people swear they see a blue flame dancing on the sea.
rumor.grandline.story.long_ring_long_lan: The Tug-of-Tides has one rule: no cheating. It has been broken every single year.
rumor.grandline.story.lvneel: King Haakon still keeps an empty chair at his table for an explorer who never came back.
rumor.grandline.story.marineford: The scaffold is already built. The Fleet Admiral inspects it every morning, and nobody knows what she thinks.
rumor.grandline.story.new_world_gate: Welcome to the New World. Half the crews that pass this gate turn back within a week. The other half don't come back at all.
rumor.grandline.story.onigashima: The Kraken will bet on anything — dice, duels, the weather. He has never lost a wager he couldn't make someone else pay for.
rumor.grandline.story.orange_town: Without the band, the marmalade festival just isn't the same. Carmen's trumpet could rattle the shutters three streets away.
rumor.grandline.story.punk_hazard: Something on Punk Hazard glows blue at night, and it isn't the ice.
rumor.grandline.story.rusukaina: The hermit of Rusukaina hasn't said a word in nine years. People travel from the New World to hear him say nothing.
rumor.grandline.story.sabaody_archipelag: Every rookie crew in the world seems to be here at once. The Marines are... nervous.
rumor.grandline.story.shells_town: Nobody says it out loud, but the Justice Levy goes straight into Captain Gallowgate's pockets. His collar's real gold, you know.
rumor.grandline.story.shiokaze_isle: Old Fumio says he sailed with the Saltfire King. He also says he once out-wrestled a Sea King, so take that as you will.
rumor.grandline.story.sorbet_kingdom: King Gelato issued forty-three royal decrees last year. Thirty-nine were about dessert.
rumor.grandline.story.spider_miles: The Scrap Baron buys every broken cannon in the North Blue. Nobody knows what he's building.
rumor.grandline.story.syrup_village: Tomas Kajitori was the best helmsman in the East Blue until his wreck. Now he won't even row a dinghy.
rumor.grandline.story.thriller_bark: If you see your reflection walking around without you, run.
rumor.grandline.story.twin_capes: The old lighthouse keeper's sister was the Saltfire King's navigator. They say she knows the way to the end of the world.
rumor.grandline.story.wano_country: In Wano they say the Kraken lets them breathe. They say it very quietly.
rumor.grandline.story.water_7: Someone tried to kill the Guildmaster last week. The new secretary was very calm about it. Very calm.
rumor.grandline.story.whisky_peak: Never fall asleep at a party in Whisky Peak. Never.
rumor.grandline.story.whole_cake_island: Visitors to the Midnight Carnival have a wonderful time. Forever. Nobody remembers them leaving because they didn't.
rumor.grandline.story.zou: Zou walks. The whole island. On the back of something enormous. Don't ask the Minks what — they'll just smile.
